name: TC-BUS-03: lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on New Buses
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Buses/BusListing.cy.js#Buses - BusListing [newBuses] [en] — New Buses TC-BUS-03: lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on New Buses
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BUS-03
**Title:** Lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on New Buses
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the New Buses page, open the lead form via "Check Bus Price", fill a valid name, an invalid (5-digit) mobile number, and leave city empty, then submit.

**Expected Result:**
The bus enquiry popup rejects the invalid mobile number in real time (the field reverts to empty), and submitting shows the mobile-required and location-required validation messages, with no lead submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the New Buses page
2. Click "Check Bus Price" to open its lead form
3. Fill a valid name and an invalid mobile number
4. Submit with city left empty
5. Verify the mobile-required and location validation messages are shown
